readme.run: Segment a wound photograph and compute planimetry and RYB tissue fractions
notes: Input is a JPEG or PNG clinical wound photograph.
Calibrate to mm/cm^2 with --mm-per-pixel N, --pixels-per-mm N, or --ruler X1,Y1,X2,Y2 --scale-mm N.
Pass --seed X,Y to select a specific wound component, or omit for automatic Otsu segmentation.
No network connection is required and no external model weights are downloaded.
Research and educational use only — heuristic color-based RYB estimates are not a clinical diagnosis.
